style: Retro pixel art selected by the user
purpose: Bundled production sprites, not mockup images

Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: one production-ready retro pixel-art game sprite on a genuinely transparent background, no UI or text. Authentic hand-crafted 16-bit sprite art with deliberate SQUARE PIXEL CLUSTERS, crisp stepped outline, controlled 16-color-style palette, no anti-aliasing, no smooth painted gradients, no blur or soft glow. Consistent light from upper left, navy dark outlines and bright readable highlights. Fill the canvas with ONE centered isolated sprite with only 5 percent transparent margin. No ground shadow, no cast shadow outside the sprite, no frame, no badge, no caption, no checkerboard painted into the image. Designed to remain recognizable when rendered very small with nearest-neighbor scaling.

Complete opaque disk, fully round silhouette, transparent outside the disk. The entire planet must be opaque with no holes. No eyes, face, smile, orbit, rings, stars, spacecraft, number or score stripe. The planet disk is the only object.
